decision: Preserve original authoritative damage at all times; smooth only the observed health bar loss.
restored: original target switching and elapsed-time handling
raw_damage_basis: fixed attack 100, before mitigation, includes immediate hit and each due boundary hit; arithmetic and mocked production tests, not in-engine HP measurements

limitations: No live rendered validation or frame-time measurements in this change; the active match was not restarted or unpaused.
